title: Small 3D game prototype made only with a local AI model (Qwen3.8-27b)
author: marsilainen
selftext: The Qwen3.8-27B model was released this weekend, and I decided to test it by creating a small game prototype. The game itself is pretty simple, and the big-boy models could achieve this pretty easily, but the fact that this is doable purely on a small, locally running model is quite impressive. The model coded it, created the procedural low-poly models, designed and built the map, and added sounds. The model was served from Unsloth and the agent was the zoo code on code-oss.
